settings.text: We approach each formula as an entirely new variation — combining approaches that are foundational and forward-thinking, bringing together ingredients you wouldn’t expect at entirely unprecedented levels to target more problems for more people than anyone ever thought possible.

settings.title: Our peak performance powerhouse
settings.description: Our Symphonic MDs created BioA3, a unique bio functional complex that acts as a bodyguard for the active ingredients we include in our formulas. BioA3 protects our active ingredients—ensuring their stability, action, and effects. It also allows us to use these active ingredients at much higher levels and combine them in ways that might otherwise irritate skin because of its “A3” benefits: anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-oxidant.

settings.title: In Sync with Your Inside and Outside
settings.description: We address the root cause of skin issues: the inflammation that is the body’s innate response to injury. And we treat your skin as a unified whole. Common types of skin inflammation include eczema, rosacea, acne, and sun damage—caused by everything from sun exposure to ingredients like retinol. Our scientists have found ways to harness the powerful anti-inflammatory properties of immunomodulators to make ingredients that might otherwise irritate the skin help it heal.

settings.title: Four Pillars
settings.description: Every formulation we create contains gold-standard ingredients that fall under the four pillars of cosmetological development—peptides, retinoids, AHAs, and Vitamin C. These four pillars of ingredients are the most consistently proven to work and form the foundation of our products. We source these ingredients from the most trusted suppliers on the planet and precisely dose them for maximum efficacy.
